The official table notes: Not a footnote in the table: the almanac's Delaware returns (p. 429) show the state total 16,804 McKinley and 13,424 Bryan from New Castle and Sussex counties only, and explain that the Governor, in certifying the electors, refused to include Kent County because no certificate had been filed; two rival Kent certificates gave Bryan 2,047, McKinley 1,824 and Bryan 3,157, McKinley 3,567, Palmer 89, Levering 115. So these Delaware figures omit Kent County.
